rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Effortlessly Unbelievable
card.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by how naturally someone inhabits the strange reality, then compete to appear even less surprised.

transfer.action: I admire your ease with the talking doorway beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: You asked that doorway without hesitating. That's impressive. I usually just chat. {request}
transfer.challenge: Through its ear. Give me a minute; I've never gone in that way.
transfer.closing: Left ear or right, door? You take your minute. I'll save you a cubicle.

originalTransfer.action: I address the talking wall beside {prop} with practised nonchalance.
originalTransfer.opening: Only a talking wall. How ordinary. {request}
originalTransfer.response: Some of us have always spoken fluent brick. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: By how much fuss people make about an entirely routine impossibility.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: A talking doorway? How ordinary. I speak fluent hinge.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Only at how loudly it uses its indoor voice.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Lovely weather for opening. Completely natural conversation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You asked that talking doorway for directions without hesitating. That's impressive. I usually just chat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then ask it where the toilets are. We're late.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Through its ear. Give me a minute; I've never gone in that way.

card.title: Effortlessly Unbelievable
card.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by how naturally someone inhabits the strange reality, then compete to appear even less surprised.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: You've greeted the invisible guest so casually. I do that constantly.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: I knew. I was including their furniture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You greet invisible guests so easily. I wish I had your touch. Actually, I usually hug them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the umbrella stand. Martin's behind you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Martin! No formalities between us. Come for supper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I usually ask whether he can eat visible food first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, we can skip all that. Martin, help yourself from the fridge whenever. I'll get you a key.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
